arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, sys, subprocess, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'project')
from request import validate
# find max K such that traffic fits: 4*4154*4K + N*(16D+32) <= 256MiB
D=1024; N=4096
per = 4*(4154)*4
budget = 256*1024*1024 - N*(16*D+32)
K = budget//per
print('max K', K)
evs=[]
for r in range(4):
    evs.append({'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0,'count':K,'step':1})
evs.append({'op':'snap','tag':'full'})
c={'primitive':'allgather','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':K+50,'words':D,'capacity':N,'start':0,
   'events':evs,'trace':0}
r={'cases':[c]}
print(validate(r))
open('/tmp/big5.json','w').write(json.dumps(r))
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','project/solver.py'],
                 stdin=open('/tmp/big5.json','rb'), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
ru=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('%.2fs rc=%d peak-rss=%d MiB out=%d' % (time.time()-t, p.returncode, ru.ru_maxrss//1024, len(p.stdout)))
print(p.stdout[:300])
EOF
